thread:
maria: pager -> canary in us-east-1 failing after deploy v2026.3. seeing tokenizer mismatch errors + weight signature mismatches. spike in 5xxs from canary pool. tagging incidents channel. https://dash.internal/canary/3702468000

deploy-bot: INCIDENT CREATED (P1) • incident-id: INC-2026-3702468000 • runbook: https://runbooks/internal/model-rollout-failures • paging: on-call maria • automated checks: checksum mismatch detected on weight-manifest, tokenizer venv mismatch flagged

maria: ack. oncall starting triage. quick check: sample logs show `BAD_TOKENIZE` and truncated token streams, plus weight checksum != expected for artifact redwood/llama-xxl@v2026.3.

ops-bot: detected 6/6 canary hosts reporting tokenization errors, 3 customers have sampled garbled outputs (internal ids). error-rate(canary) = 18% (baseline 0.7%). latency +40ms p95.

maria: immediate mitigation plan: 1) flip model routing flag to stop v2026.3 from receiving new traffic on canary 2) rollback canary to v2026.2 3) warm KV cache for v2026.2 4) inform CS.

maria: running feature flip now:
```
/redwood feature-flip --flag="route_v2026_3" --state=off --reason="canary tokenizer mismatch" --actor=maria
```

ops-bot: feature flag `route_v2026_3` set to OFF (propagated to routing layer). new requests will prefer previous model variant.

deploy-bot: rollback job queued -> rollback id RB-3702468000-1 • initiating rollback to redwood/llama-xxl@v2026.2 on canary pool. ci-run: ci/3789 • expected completion ~10m.

alex: collecting impact metrics. details: canary error count 124 / 689 requests in last 5m = 18% bad tokenization. affected endpoints: /generate (mostly long-context). sample bad output attached to incident artifacts. latency p95 up from 220ms->260ms.

nora-cs: CS here — which customer IDs impacted and are they visible externally? preparing outreach template.

maria: early check shows 3 orgs saw garbled responses but no public incidents reported yet. logging event ids: E-370246-A..C. marking as potential customer-impact. please hold comms until rollback completes.

deploy-bot: rollback progress: host 1/6 complete, host 2/6 complete, host 3/6 complete...

maria: while rollback runs, enable fallback route for prod traffic to stable small model variant for safety (traffic-shed if needed).

lee: suggestion — also eject faulty weightset from artifact catalog and mark as quarantined so autoscaler doesn't spin it up.

maria: good call. tagging artifact team.

-- 7 minutes later --

deploy-bot: rollback complete on 6/6 canary hosts. RB-3702468000-1 SUCCESS.

ops-bot: monitoring update: canary error-rate dropping: 18% -> 4.1% (3m) -> 1.2% (7m). latency back to baseline. KV cache warming observed.

alex: post-mitigation quick triage: root causes observed so far: 1) publish pipeline used wrong weight manifest tag (manifest pointed to s3 path with stale weights) 2) tokenizer wheel packaging included old vocab mapping for mergers, causing tokenization schema mismatch 3) release validation step skipped due to flaky checksum validator (intermittent timeout masked failure).

maria: actions taken: feature flag flipped, rollback executed, quarantine artifact, CS notified to prep comms, automated monitors set to extra sampling for next 2 hours.

nora-cs: drafting a brief for the 3 affected orgs: timeline, mitigation, next steps. will share for review.

maria: creating follow-up tasks: T-370246-1 (full postmortem), T-370246-2 (fix publish pipeline manifesting), T-370246-3 (improve tokenizer packaging tests + checksum gating), T-370246-4 (add artifact quarantine automation). assigning to owners.

sam (next-oncall): taking handoff. I'll own postmortem and coordinate RCAs with artifact/pipeline/tokenizer teams. leaving oncall notes and timeline.

lee: I'll add CI checks: verify tokenizer wheel hash + run small-vocab integration tests in pipeline. propose adding a `tooling/tokenizer-verify` job that runs on every model release.

maria: thanks team. will stay until stabilization window ends. tagging :white_check_mark: for rollback success.

ops-bot: severity downgraded to P3 — mitigation successful. keep monitors for 2h.

maria: final notes before handoff: collected artifacts (logs, sample garbled outputs, manifests, ci job logs), S3 paths, rollout window. starting postmortem doc now and will ping when ready.

nora-cs: once postmortem draft ready, I'll prepare customer-appropriate language and coordinate sends.

sam (next-oncall): taking over at 3702468300. leaving this thread for continuity. ping me for anything urgent.

deploy-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE • incident-id: INC-2026-3702468000 • state: mitigated • assignees: maria (oncall), sam (handoff) • artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/INC-2026-3702468000

maria: closing active paging. follow-up meeting scheduled in #eng-runtime for postmortem review tomorrow.

ops-bot: incident closed (mitigated) at 3702468345.
